from solution import greater_specificnum
import inspect


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: greater_specificnum([220, 330, 500], 200)==True."""
    result = greater_specificnum([220, 330, 500], 200)
    assert result == True  # 220>200=True, 330>200=True, 500>200=True => True


def test_issue_all_greater_basic():
    """Rule: find all values greater than specified number returns True when all exceed it."""
    result = greater_specificnum([5, 6, 7], 4)
    assert result == True  # 5>4=True, 6>4=True, 7>4=True => True


def test_issue_single_just_above():
    """Rule: value just above threshold counts as greater than specified number."""
    result = greater_specificnum([201], 200)
    assert result == True  # 201-200=1 >0 => True


def test_issue_all_just_above():
    """Rule: find all values greater than specified number returns True when each is just above."""
    result = greater_specificnum([201, 202, 203], 200)
    assert result == True  # 201>200=True, 202>200=True, 203>200=True => True


def test_issue_all_equal_boundary():
    """Rule: greater than means strictly greater, so equal values are not greater."""
    result = greater_specificnum([200, 200, 200], 200)
    assert result == False  # 200>200=False, 200>200=False, 200>200=False => False


def test_issue_single_equal_boundary():
    """Rule: greater than means strictly greater, so a single equal value is not greater."""
    result = greater_specificnum([200], 200)
    assert result == False  # 200-200=0 >0 is False => False


def test_issue_single_just_below():
    """Rule: value just below threshold does not count as greater than specified number."""
    result = greater_specificnum([199], 200)
    assert result == False  # 199-200=-1 >0 is False => False


def test_issue_none_greater_well_below():
    """Rule: find all values greater than specified number returns False when none exceed it."""
    result = greater_specificnum([10, 20, 30], 100)
    assert result == False  # 10>100=False, 20>100=False, 30>100=False => False


def test_issue_negative_all_greater():
    """Rule: greater than works for negatives when all values exceed the specified number."""
    result = greater_specificnum([-5, -4, -3], -10)
    assert result == True  # -5>-10=True, -4>-10=True, -3>-10=True => True


def test_issue_mixed_returns_bool():
    """Rule: find all values greater than specified number returns a boolean."""
    result = greater_specificnum([220, 100, 500], 200)
    assert isinstance(result, bool) == True  # 2 cases mixed => check type is bool => True


def test_issue_empty_returns_bool():
    """Rule: find all values greater than specified number handles an empty list."""
    result = greater_specificnum([], 200)
    assert isinstance(result, bool) == True  # 0 elements => check type is bool => True


def test_contract_callable():
    """Contract: solution.greater_specificnum is callable."""
    assert callable(greater_specificnum) == True  # callable exists => True, 1==1 => True


def test_contract_two_params():
    """Contract: greater_specificnum(list, num) takes two parameters."""
    params = inspect.signature(greater_specificnum).parameters
    assert len(params) == 2  # 1+1=2 params => 2
